ignore.name: .mod-left.workspace-drawer
ignore.reason: Obsidian adds both mod-left/mod-right and mod-primary/mod-secondary to mobile drawers through its "mod-{side}" class template, so the old class still matches; Obsidian's own CSS just targets the new one
